fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary promoting Miami’s healthful climate (including discussion of babies and sunshine) and local civic matters. Substantial coverage addresses milk quality and public health, including pasteurization debates and reports of tuberculosis testing in dairy herds. Contains satirical and society columns, notes on Miami Beach visitors, prohibition/bootlegging commentary and price lists, and items referencing crime news involving Al Capone. Also includes local improvement pieces (post office site proposal; Biscayne Boulevard appearance), entertainment notices, and advertisements/coupons (including Florida Power & Light and Florida East Coast Railroad).
relation: Published weekly; Miami Life Co.; issue dated Saturday, August 4, 1928
